recognize_zh: 單一高倍視野內就有十顆左右的嗜中性球，多數為分葉核或帶狀核（band），細胞質內顆粒明顯，但沒有芽細胞、骨髓球或嗜鹼性球增加；白血球密度明顯上升而細胞形態成熟，符合嗜中性球增多（neutrophilia）。
features: Markedly increased number of neutrophils in a single high-power field
Mature segmented neutrophils admixed with band forms with C- or U-shaped nuclei
Pink-violet cytoplasmic granules that appear prominent, possibly representing mild toxic granulation
No blasts, myelocytes, basophils or Döhle bodies clearly identified; normocytic red cells with rare platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a marked increase in neutrophils, with numerous mature segmented forms and several band forms in a single field. The neutrophils have clumped chromatin and conspicuous pink-violet cytoplasmic granules, suggestive of mild toxic granulation; no blasts, myelocytes or basophilia are seen in this field. Red cells are normocytic without significant poikilocytosis. Findings are consistent with neutrophilia with mild left shift, most often reactive, and correlation with the absolute neutrophil count and clinical context is recommended.

ddx.vs: CML shows a full spectrum of granulocytic precursors with a myelocyte peak, basophilia and eosinophilia with BCR::ABL1, rather than mature neutrophils and bands only.
CNL shows sustained mature neutrophilia with <10% precursors often with toxic granulation, and requires exclusion of reactive causes and demonstration of CSF3R mutation.
A leukemoid reaction is reactive neutrophilia above 50 x 10^9/L with toxic changes and left shift but no basophilia, dysplasia or clonal markers, and resolves with the underlying cause.
Dysplastic neutrophils show hypolobated bilobed nuclei with condensed chromatin and hypogranular cytoplasm, unlike the well-granulated normally lobulated cells here.
